_comment: Boss soul forging (cooks/endgame.md 2.7, cooks/build-endgame.md 2.3). A major boss drops its soul to each looter: drop.first on your first kill, drop.repeat + drop.perAL x the party's Artifact Level after, x drop.phase3Mult in its hidden third phase, drop.geisAt: a first kill at that AL or more always drops. At the boss's own altar (Forge soul): A awakens the boss's weapon (its blueprint weapon from the bag, any quality / upgrade: metal factor becomes starsteel, the element fixed, the Soul art is yours while it's held), B makes the soul talisman. A second soul buys the other; after both, a soul salvages there into salvage.item x salvage.count. Soul arts are weapon arts (tuning wildbrands.<art>), held in a quick slot while the awakened weapon is in your hand: 25 stamina, 30 s. live: the boss exists in this build (rows of bosses not built yet stay hidden until they ship). All first drafts.

art.name: Vulkarn's Flood
art.line: An overhead slam that splits the ground: a 6 m crack of lava ahead for 4 s.

talisman.name: Forge-heart
talisman.line: Path resource fills 10% faster while you're above 70% health.

art.name: Pillar-breaker
art.line: A driving thrust whose frost bursts along the ground ahead: a 4 m line of ice spikes, heavy frostbite, three times the stance damage.

talisman.name: Rime-scale
talisman.line: The first blow you take after 10 s unhurt deals 30% less.

art.name: Rod-call
art.line: A stab that marks; 1 s later lightning strikes the mark from above (a 1 s glow on the ground).

talisman.name: Storm-eye
talisman.line: Sprint 6% faster; the roll after a parry costs no stamina.

art.name: Noon
art.line: Plant the maul: a 6 m sundial ring for 6 s; allies inside crit 20% more, enemies inside are blinded.

talisman.name: Sun-dial
talisman.line: +8% damage outdoors by day, -4% at night.

art.name: Re-root
art.line: A slam that roots everything in 5 m for 2 s; stand still after and heal 5% over 5 s.

talisman.name: Heart-tree seed
talisman.line: Potions heal a further 15% over 6 s.

art.name: Serpent's gale
art.line: A shot charged to 1.2 s: one arrow x3 that pierces and pushes (straight, never homing).

talisman.name: Serpent's feather
talisman.line: Falls hurt half as much; jump attacks +15%.

art.name: Prism split
art.line: A thrust in three lines of light 15 degrees apart.

talisman.name: Prism
talisman.line: Guard +10; a shot you block sends a quarter of its damage back along its line.

art.name: Mire drink
art.line: A 300 degree sweep that bleeds and heals you a tenth of what it deals.

art.name: Leviathan's hook
art.line: Throw the harpoon on its chain (straight): pull a small foe to you, or yourself to a large one.

talisman.name: Leviathan's breath
talisman.line: Hold your breath twice as long; stamina +10% in rain or water.

art.name: Procession
art.line: A wide reap; each foe it hits gives you path resource.

art.name: Fruiting
art.line: A slam that plants a spore cap; it bursts 1.5 s later in a 4 m poison cloud.

talisman.name: Hive-heart
talisman.line: Poison and rot build on you 25% slower.

art.name: Swallow
art.line: A 4 m lunge; a kill gives back 10 max health the void took.

talisman.name: Void-heart's shell
talisman.line: Max health lost to the void comes back twice as fast out of a fight.
